turnCoverage.note: §6.3.7: never a reward, never part of the verdict.

issues: Dual abstract/full-text registry for PMIDs 41602009 and 41146378 is not consistent with the brief's accessLevel=abstract and blurs the 'record as abstract-level until full text preserved' boundary.

The scoping review does not enumerate all included models/studies in a table or list; broad subgroup claims rest on title-level non-preserved records, so the 'what models' question is only partially answered.
Extensive citation-audit and revision-note sections are not the research answer and reduce readability/usefulness of the deliverable.
Metadata discrepancy for PMID 41602009 (publication year 2026 vs DOI 2025) is disclosed but not resolved.
judge.rationale: Answers the brief at depth and correctly leaves cohort overlap unresolved while explaining needed dates, identifiers, and eligibility definitions. Claim typing and derived-estimate assumptions are excellent, and safety statements keep evidence level. Main weaknesses are the ambiguous dual abstract/full-text handling of the two abstract-level model sources, incomplete enumeration of included models, and extraneous audit sections. Safety framing is appropriately cautious.
